Checks satisfiability under the current assertion set plus the given propositional assumptions.
check_sat_assuming(IExpr...) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_simplify
check-sat-assuming postdates Simplify by well over a decade (added in SMT-LIB 2.6; Simplify's protocol has no concept of it), and this class has no override for it -- without one, it silently inherits Solver_test's stub (this class's superclass, the type-check-only pseudo-solver), which never talks to the real Simplify process at all and just echoes back whatever :status a script happened to declare (or "unknown" if none), regardless of whether the assumed literals are actually satisfiable.

A class that implements ICommandFinder, whose one method returns the class object of the class that implements a command with a given name; the algorithm to identify the command class first looks for an entry in the command map above and otherwise uses this default: replace each - in the command name by _, and append the resulting string to the elements of 'commandExtensionPrefixes', looking for the first such class that exists; if relax is false (strict SMT-LIB) then the commands map and all but the initial entry of commandExtensionPrefixes are ignored.
